errors.text_span: displays proportions of 36.2%, 20.1%, 36.8%, and 7.0% for the teal, yellow, orange, and red slices
errors.evidence: The description for the 'hard' chart swaps the values for the teal and yellow slices. It states that the teal slice is 36.2% and the yellow slice is 20.1%, but the figure shows the teal slice is 20.1% and the yellow slice is 36.2%.
The legend is not located 'in the hard chart'; it is a separate element to the right of the three charts that applies to all of them.
